enrichment method: This result confirms that the extraction procedure selectively enriched the membrane proteins.
instrument: LC–MS/MS was carried out using an RSLCnano HPLC system (Dionex, UK) and an LTQ-Orbitrap-Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: with the output of the column sprayed directly into the nanospray ion source of the LTQ-Orbitrap-Velos mass spectrometer.
labeling: Next, peptides were labelled using the TMPsixplex kit to compare the relative abundance of membrane proteins in TMP and MIND
precursor tolerance: The peptide tolerance was set to 10 ppm and the MS/MS tolerance was set to 0.02 Da.
fragment tolerance: The peptide tolerance was set to 10 ppm and the MS/MS tolerance was set to 0.02 Da.
ptm: Fixed modifications were set as carbamidomethyl (C) and variable modifications set as oxidation (M).
